hook: Ek group se mann nahi bhara? [[Do columns]] se group karo

slides.title: [[Combo]] group
points: GROUP BY dept, city → **dept + city** combo
slides.note: Jaise burger + fries ka **combo meal**: alag alag nahi, jodi mein

slides.title: Do columns, [[ek GROUP BY]]
slides.code:
SELECT dept, city,
  COUNT(*) AS people
FROM employees
GROUP BY dept, city;

slides.title: [[Result]]
slides.note: IT ab **do tukdon** mein: Delhi aur Mumbai alag ✂️

slides.title: [[Order]] matter karta?
slides.note: Groups same banenge. Output ka order chahiye to **ORDER BY** lagao

slides.title: SELECT ka [[rule]]
slides.note: MySQL 5.7+ mein ONLY_FULL_GROUP_BY default ON, error dega

slides.wrong:
SELECT dept, city, name,
  COUNT(*)
FROM employees
GROUP BY dept, city;
slides.why: IT-Delhi group mein 2 naam hain. SQL **kaunsa** dikhaye? 🤷
